svg.aria-label: Tools I use. Languages: Java 21, TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, SQL. Backend: Spring Boot 3, FastAPI, Node.js, REST APIs, OpenAPI, OAuth 2.1, Microservices, SSE streaming, State machines. Frontend: React 19, Vite, Electron. Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, MySQL, OpenSearch, Data migrations, OCR ingestion. Cloud: Google Cloud Run, Firebase Auth, Secret Manager, AWS S3, Lambda, CloudFormation, ECS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Maven. AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, LiteLLM, MCP servers, Agent runtimes, Tool calling, Structured outputs, Grounded retrieval, Embeddings, Knowledge graphs, Guardrails, Realtime voice, Claude Code, Codex. Quality: Playwright, Selenium, Cucumber, REST Assured, Postman, WireMock, pytest, Vitest, JUnit 5, TestNG, Testcontainers, ArchUnit, JMeter, Gatling, axe-core, Section 508 · WCAG. Also: UX research, Graphic design, Curriculum design, Technical discovery, Agile coaching.
